calico.name: Calico Cat
calico.bio: Your cat. Sits against your side while you read and purrs loud enough to feel.
calico.hint: She is happiest when you are simply nearby.

kitten_grey.name: Silver Kitten
kitten_grey.bio: Found asleep in a planter outside the flower stall, paws tucked under.
kitten_grey.hint: Move slowly. She startles, then forgives instantly.

cat_ginger.name: Ginger Loaf
cat_ginger.bio: Folds into a perfect loaf on the warmest tile in the building and stays there.
cat_ginger.hint: Warmth first, food second, fuss never.

dog_shiba.name: Sesame Shiba
dog_shiba.bio: Ran three laps of the park before letting anyone close, grinning the whole way.
dog_shiba.hint: Tire him out first. Trust comes after the running.

cat_white.name: Cloud Cat
cat_white.bio: Watches from the top of the carousel railing and comes down only when it is quiet.
cat_white.hint: Sit still and wait. She decides when.

dog_poodle.name: Honey Poodle
dog_poodle.bio: Greets every single person on the path, then checks that nobody was left out.
dog_poodle.hint: He gives affection first. Give it back.
